notes.subject: and slaughter the apostates have made it deep
notes.rationale: one of the darkest verses in Hosea: שחטה read as noun 'slaughter' or participle 'slaughterers'; שטים as 'apostates' or 'Shittim'; some render 'the rebels have gone deep in slaughtering'

notes.subject: שֵׂטִים
notes.rationale: this form occurs only here in the Tanakh

notes.subject: am
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks a copula between ואני and מוסר

notes.subject: I am discipline for them all
notes.rationale: YHWH's undisclosed intent toward the apostates, voiced without explanation

translation: And slaughter — the apostates have made it deep, and I ⟨am⟩ discipline for them all.
